#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json,os,sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
TOKEN="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/.concurrency-ledger/client.token"
URL="http://127.0.0.1:18766/v1/operations"
if len(sys.argv)>2:
    raise SystemExit("usage: concurrency-ledger-call [request.json|-]")
source=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)==2 else "-"
if source=="-":
    request=json.load(sys.stdin)
else:
    request=json.load(open(source,encoding="utf-8"))
token=open(TOKEN,encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
payload=json.dumps(request,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request(
    URL,data=payload,method="POST",
    headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token,"Content-Type":"application/json"},
)
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as r:
        body=r.read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body=e.read()
    sys.stderr.write(body.decode("utf-8","replace")+"\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
sys.stdout.write(body.decode("utf-8")+"\n")
